resources.string: Save your library, progress and settings. Pick up where you left off on a new phone.
No backup from this phone yet
Your saved copies will appear here.
Allow access to Downloads to export this backup.
This removes the copy from your Telegram archive. Your current library and progress stay on this phone.
Use your Telegram account. Nyanime creates a private archive for your backups.
Check your phone number and selected country.
That code is incorrect. Check it and try again.
That code has expired. Request a new one.
That two-step verification password is incorrect.
Scan with Telegram on another signed-in device: Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device.
Complete the account setup requested by Telegram in its official app, then reconnect here.
Backups are stored in a private “Nyanime Backup” channel, reserved for you.
Delete copies older than this many days
Protected copies and the latest backup from each device are kept.
Disconnect this Nyanime session and stop automatic backups. Your Telegram archive will remain available.
Waiting: we will retry as soon as possible
Your backup is already up to date
Your backup is being transferred. Tap to see progress.
Telegram Cloud encryption, not end-to-end. No additional backup password. Downloads and Telegram sessions are excluded.
Telegram access has not been configured for this build yet.
Telegram could not start. Your local data is safe. Try reconnecting.
This archive is shared or no longer private. Backups are paused to protect your data.
Telegram requested a pause. Your backup will be retried later.
The operation could not finish. Your backup remains available for another attempt.
Telegram could not complete sign-in. Check the international prefix and try again, or connect with QR.
Telegram rejected this app’s API credentials. Nyanime needs a correction before connecting.
Telegram requires a newer authentication engine. Update Nyanime to connect.
Telegram does not allow sign-in with this number. Check the account in its official app.
Telegram cannot send a code for this sign-in. Try QR from an already connected device.
Enter your number: we add the country code. You can also paste a complete international number.
Enter the code Telegram sent you. Check Telegram on your other devices too.
Your account uses two-step verification. Enter your Telegram password.
The complete backup includes libraries, reading and viewing progress, history, tracking, settings and supported extension data. Only you have access to the private backup channel.
Enter the code Telegram sent to your email address.
Already have a backup? After signing in, we will find your copies so you can pick up where you left off. You can also start without Cloud and connect it from More.
Bring back your library, reading and watching progress. Review this copy before you start.
Includes %1$d extensions. The app restores RIN packages; missing APK extensions require Android confirmation. Downloaded media and your Telegram session stay on this phone.
Some sources or services are not available on this device yet. We will recover their data; you may need to finish setting them up.
You can leave this screen: restoration continues and you will receive a notification when it finishes.
Ready to pick up where you left off
Restoration is complete. You can return to your library.
Could not recover %1$d items. Review the details before continuing; the original copy remains in your archive.
The report is unavailable. Check the restore notification.
Your Cloud copy is safe. You can retry restoring it.
This copy did not pass validation. Choose another backup; the data on this phone has not been changed.
Another restoration is running. Wait for it to finish before starting a different one.
